title: Bolt Help Center: guides and support for building with Bolt - Bolt

facts.fact: Each Bolt example project can be copied for free from the Bolt Templates marketplace.
facts.quote: Each example below is a real project that you can copy for free from the **Bolt Templates** marketplace.

facts.fact: Email support for product and technical questions is available only to paid plan users.
facts.quote: Email support for product and technical questions is available to paid plan users.

facts.fact: Community support through the Bolt Discord community is available to all users.
facts.quote: Community support is available to all in the [Bolt Discord community](https://discord.com/invite/stackblitz).

facts.fact: Free plan users are directed to Discord for support.
facts.quote: **If you’re on a free plan**: Reach out for support on Discord, where you can find knowledgeable community members who may be able to help.

facts.fact: Bolt's paid-plan support team responds Monday through Friday during business hours.
facts.value: Monday through Friday, during business hours
facts.quote: Our team responds Monday through Friday during business hours.

facts.fact: Bolt Support cannot look up an account using an email address other than the one associated with the Bolt account.
facts.quote: For security reasons, Bolt Support can’t look up your account using a different email address.
